skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role and necessity of real estate management, the purposes and contents of real estate management tasks, and the importance of real estate management in maintaining the image of the investor, enhancing the value of real estate, ensuring safety and convenience for users, reducing risks, and minimizing operational costs.
Apply knowledge to manage real estate operations safely, efficiently, and cost-effectively.

Analyze and evaluate real estate from both technical and specialized activity perspectives to develop a specific real estate management plan; build and implement marketing strategies for selling or leasing real estate.
Demonstrate professional ethics, persistence, and teamwork in work.
Develop systematic thinking and information gathering skills.
Refine acute thinking skills and stay updated on real estate management scenarios.
Refine planning skills in real estate management.
Demonstrate personal responsibility and group responsibility, participate and organize group activities.
Express and defend personal views based on objective and scientific approaches.
Identify and fulfill social and professional ethical responsibilities in making judgments and evaluations on professional issues in real estate management.

Manage relationships with property owners and tenants, develop and implement marketing strategies for real estate, manage property maintenance and construction, and negotiate and manage real estate rental contracts.
Manage negotiation and rental contracts for real estate.
Prepare and manage financial reports and risks in real estate management.
